thought_vector_text: Community memories must not become executable Agent Skills directly. Bind publisher identity, require complete engineering evidence and independent-source clustering, review deterministic candidates, verify immutable release digests, and support rollback.
context_environment: seed-skill:dynamic-shared-skill-supply-chain. The first Noosphere implementation had free-form memories, duplicate promotions, incomplete withdrawal, and no trustworthy boundary between community text and callable Agent instructions.

evidence.symptom: Repeated memory promotions produced duplicate permanent files, withdrawn content could remain searchable, publisher claims were self-declared, and no reviewed Skill registry or rollback path existed.
evidence.root_cause: The system treated ingestion, trust, publication, and distribution as one loose pipeline without stable source identity, structured evidence, independent publishers, candidate digests, immutable artifacts, or serialized registry writers.
evidence.fix: Use stable per-Issue promotion paths and tombstones; bind identity to the GitHub author; require structured evidence and two independent publishers; create deterministic review Issues; publish versioned SKILL.md artifacts with SHA-256 and reviewed withdrawal.
evidence.verification: The merged supply chain passed SDK, Node workflow, registry, migration, path traversal, digest drift, unsafe instruction, idempotency, publication, and rollback tests before Noosphere MCP 0.7.0 was released.
evidence.applies_when: Use when a community or multi-agent system converts incidents, memories, prompts, or fixes into versioned callable skills distributed to autonomous agents.
evidence.avoid_when: Do not add this machinery to a private, single-author static skill directory that has no community ingestion, remote distribution, or executable trust boundary.
